_comment: Public deal tracker config. Each shop_watch entry needs a domain (must serve /products.json - Shopify only), a category and an affiliate_network. Affiliate links: set awin_publisher_id once your Awin publisher account exists; each Awin shop has its advertiser ID in awin_mid. Flip a shop's affiliate_live to true only after Awin shows you as APPROVED for that advertiser - until then its links stay plain retailer links.

shop_watches.name: Sainte Cellier
shop_watches._note: Niche/artisanal fragrance boutique, confirmed Shopify. UNVERIFIED: site may default to USD not GBP - check the first scan's actual prices against real listings before trusting this shop's output. Affiliate programme not yet checked.

shop_watches.name: Les Senteurs
shop_watches._note: Belgravia niche perfumery since 1984, confirmed Shopify. Genuine compare_at_price markdowns confirmed live (not checkout-code discounts) via a real seasonal sale collection. Prestigious brand roster: Frederic Malle, Clive Christian, Maison Francis Kurkdjian, Creed, Kilian Paris. Affiliate programme not yet checked.

shop_watches.name: WatchNation
shop_watches._note: Confirmed Shopify, confirmed Awin affiliate programme live. Genuine authorised dealer - Hamilton, Marathon, Squale, Nivada Grenchen, Seiko, Orient among others.

shop_watches.name: Michael Stewart
shop_watches._note: Added Oct 2026. Shopify, Awin (30-day cookie). Around 84% of in-stock products carried a was-price when checked, so its markdowns lean on price history before they rank - expect few of its items in the feed until history builds.

category_exclude._comment: Extra terms that rule a product out of a category. Jura lists Swarovski Christmas ornaments as jewellery, which put two in the Watches feed.

min_price_by_category._comment: Checks the ORIGINAL price, not the discounted one - a steep genuine markdown on a decent item (£45 cap down to £15) shouldn't be filtered out for being a good deal. This screens out items that were always cheap, not items that have become cheap through a real discount.

notable_brands._comment: The score boost applies to the whole list below. Auto-generated brand notes only fire for entries in 'facts', which are deliberately a smaller subset - only brands with a fact actually checked against a source, not guessed. Add more as they're verified; per-item overrides always take priority and live in notes.json.
